name: claude-dock
description: Lore - a clean, minimal dock of AI assistant sessions for macOS
author: Matthew Molinar
//: electron is a runtime dependency, not a devDependency, because `npx claude-dock` must be able to launch it. That rules out electron-builder, which refuses to package an app with electron in dependencies. Packaging as a .dmg would mean moving electron to devDependencies and giving up the npx install path.
